Moneycontrol Sports Desk - October 15, 2026 / 18:15 IST PM meets Asian Games medal winners (X/BJP4India) Prime Minister Narendra Modi met the Asian Games 2026 medal winners at the Major Dhyan Chand Stadium in New Delhi on Thursday.
India won a total of 85 medals at the Games - 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze.
The Prime Minister also underlined the splendid show by women athletes, highlighting that 38 medals out of the total 85 were won by them.

He added that 11 among the 38 were gold, calling it "a very special moment for India."
